title: config/rate_limits.json (versioned 1.00)
prompt:
Create config/rate_limits.json with version "1.00" and services (default, anthropic, search) each with requests_per_minute, requests_per_hour, concurrent_max, retry_after_seconds, max_retries (see docs/prds/api-gatekeeper.md). It will be loaded by Epic 13.

Follow repo standards: TDD (write the failing test first, then code); max 150 lines per code file (split, don't compress); ruff = 0 violations + mypy clean; no hard-coded values (read from config); every external API call goes through the API gatekeeper (Epic 13); log via the LOG package; keep coverage >= 85%. Read docs/PRD.md and the relevant docs/prds/*.md before starting.

usage.summary: usage to be filled by main loop from harness report

note: Ships only the data file config/rate_limits.json (Closes #14); the loader RateLimitConfig is Epic 13 task 13.1 and is deliberately NOT built here. TDD red-first: wrote tests/test_rate_limits_config.py and watched all 10 cases fail with FileNotFoundError (file absent), then added the file to make them pass. The file's shape is copied EXACTLY from docs/prds/api-gatekeeper.md §4: rate_limits.version == "1.00" and services default/anthropic/search each with the five integer keys (requests_per_minute, requests_per_hour, concurrent_max, retry_after_seconds, max_retries). default/anthropic = 30/500/5/30/3; search = 20/300/3/15/2. No Python loads these limits in this task, so there are no hard-coded values to remove and the API gatekeeper / LOG package are N/A (no external calls, no runtime code). The test resolves the path robustly via Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / 'config' / 'rate_limits.json' (repo-root relative, not cwd), matches the repo convention in tests/test_python_pin.py, asserts each value is a real int (excluding bool, since JSON booleans are Python ints), and asserts each service dict equals the sub-PRD shape exactly. Test is ~120 code lines (under the 150 gate); it is a pure data-contract test so it adds no measurable lines to the coverage source (packages/*/src only) and does not move the >=85% number. Gates green locally: ruff check . + ruff format --check . clean; mypy no issues; pytest --cov passed with coverage above threshold; check_line_limit.py exit 0; secret_scan.py exit 0 (the config has no secrets).
